name: wp-fbclid-only-organic-facebook
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] fbclid WITHOUT a paid utm_medium produces NO source/medium inference and channel 'Facebook Organic' (clicutcl-attribution.js:327-329,381-382). Only the bare fbclid field is written.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT (standing, ruled #2): engine infers source=facebook, medium=cpc, channel=paid_social and label 'Facebook Ads' from bare fbclid; plugin writes only the raw field + 'Facebook Organic'. Intentional engine deviation; requires Hugo confirmation before WP runtime swap. Original note: directly conflicts with golden meta-paid-fbclid-only (marked CONTRACT).
